86a-refraction.png: Water → air at 589 nm: reflection, refraction at 40° (n_a sin φ_a = n_b sin φ_b) and the 48.6° critical angle (Drude §1), with water’s index from its dispersion formula.
86b-lens.png: Exact ray trace through a 4 mm thick fused-silica biconvex lens (r = ±50 mm): marginal rays focus short of the paraxial focus; the thin-lens focal length 54.5 mm from Drude eq. 22 and the chromatic shift of the traced focal length.
86c-prism.png: A 60° fused-silica prism at minimum deviation for 589 nm (33.6°, Southall eq. 27): seven wavelengths from 400 to 700 nm traced through both faces, blue deviated most.
87a-two-sources.png: Two coherent sources 0.5 mm apart, screen at 1 m, 589 nm: the exact path-difference pattern and its 1.178 mm fringe spacing aλ/d (Drude §3).
87b-grating-sodium.png: A 400-line grating (d = 2 µm) in order 3 resolves the NIST sodium D lines 589.158 and 589.756 nm: resolving power hm = 1200 against the 987 needed (Drude eq. 88).
87c-thin-film.png: A 500 nm water film at normal incidence: reflection minima where 2nd cos χ = kλ (Drude eq. 17), with the reflected light against thickness at 450, 550 and 650 nm.
88a-fresnel.png: Fused silica at 589 nm: s and p reflectance against angle from Drude’s eq. 24; the p reflectance vanishes at the polarizing angle 55.56° (tan φ = n).
88b-calcite.png: Calcite at 589 nm: n_o = 1.6584 and n_e = 1.4861 (Ghosh 1999 via refractiveindex.info), the extraordinary index against direction (Drude eq. 35) and a 0.855 µm quarter-wave thickness.
